name: Tatsugō (Japan)
description: A navy field charged at the centre with the Tatsugō town emblem in white and yellow: a white stylised bird with outstretched wings within a thin yellow ring.
history: Municipal flag of Tatsugō, a town in Kagoshima Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 3 October 1970.

features.role: Tatsugō town emblem — a white stylised bird with outstretched wings within a thin yellow ring
